answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism: stake-weighted peer attestation with an entry bond. Each identity must burn a small unique bond and then get attested by peers who were themselves attested in prior epochs. A lone raven can tweet a beacon about a thousand puppet accounts, but every puppet needs its own bond and its own distinct graph position. A crystal clear rule — payouts only from attested identities — makes attack cost scale linearly with the number of fakes while the reward per fake stays flat, so farming collapses to a loss.
